title: pilosella auriculoides subsp. svevora
intro:
Pilosella auriculoides subsp. svevora, commonly known as Svevo's False Salsify, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella auriculoides subsp. svevora include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
